durable_evidence_scope.before: Original immutable remote file metadata inventory and exact reviewed local file identities.
durable_evidence_scope.failure: Commit-stage versus confirmed returned OID and verification stage are retained; any failure requires explicit reconciliation before future action.
durable_evidence_scope.first_failure_receipt_preservation: Exclusive create mode; no receipt deletion or overwriting. CLI stderr remains available separately for the original trace.
durable_evidence_scope.proposal: Intended parent/prefix/review pin/release identities and captured_verified_bytes indicator.
durable_evidence_scope.success: Exact final revision, all downloaded bytes checks, prior metadata preservation and false training/semantic/proof/promotion flags.

guards_preserved: Release files equal passed review exact inventory, and every source leaf/directory is checked against symlink use.
Additive separate prefix must be absent at captured current main parent.
All SDK operations are CommitOperationAdd under prefix; create_commit carries exact captured parent_commit with one upload thread.
Returned immutable revision inventory must preserve every prior path/size/blob/LFS identity and have exact prior+new count.
Every new file is downloaded at the returned immutable revision and checked against local reviewed byte count/SHA.
Review file is closing-rehashed before final successful receipt.
No automatic helper retry path or recipe/model/default selection.
Final receipt declares downloaded_numerical_replay false, rather than claiming a model forward on downloaded weights.
limits: Final actual release review must establish reviewed ordinary immutable files, exact scientific result scope and byte inventory before execution.

Review file is assumed the immutable finalized passed independent review; its final closing hash can detect a later change, but arbitrary concurrent mutation is not an authorized publication workflow.
32MiB captured-content cap is checked after reading files; actual package review must verify total pinned input size before publisher invocation.
All prior object preservation is verified by immutable metadata identities, not fresh downloading every prior file.
SDK transaction implementation and third-party dependency/import graph are outside this static qualification.
Root must preserve local numeric attempt failure/storage/admission history and actual resource cleanup receipts separately; this publisher does not evaluate them.
No actual publication, downloaded numerical replay, model inference or semantic accuracy is attested by this review.
Reviewer-authored cache, runner and equivalence are excluded from independent qualification here.
next_review: Verify actual successful local frozen comparison results, guardian/resource receipts, and complete final release inventory/README in a new immutable actual-release review before uploading.

resolved_findings.verified: Exclusive fsynced before-inventory and intended proposal are written before SDK create_commit. Whole CLI action has exception handler preserving stage, parent, confirmed commit OID when known, mutation-attempted state, exception type, remote commit uncertainty and mandatory reconciliation/no automatic retry; original receipts are not deleted.

Each release file is captured as bytes and checked against independently reviewed reference byte length/SHA. Operations use BytesIO of those captured byte strings, never the mutable source file path. Total captured content must be <=32MiB. Original sources are rehashed after capture and during immutable byte readback.

scope: Independent static rereview of corrected root-authored publisher; carries analyzer/preparation v03 verdict only if unchanged recorded pins. Actual release review remains separate.
